  "subject": "C18",
  "fingerprints": {
    "source": "1031a66785ea3c8df675f5796fd4c84a2ccbd182c63e4e66acbe432dcd74e9bc",
    "dependencies": "d3ce73b7804b64f7ae7f59507afb068c491dba6362ef9eaf5f7aebff28bf08da",

  },
  "scores": {
    "architecture": 9,
    "behavior": 7,
    "authority_security": 8,
    "validation": 7,
    "overall": 7
  },
  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 — Complete the Playground's local draft lifecycle, including offline editing. GatewayView renders PlaygroundPanel only with a current selected workspace (gateway-view.tsx:512-525); LocalWork merely lists a saved Playground prompt with Discard. save_playground_draft requires a fresh WorkspaceRef (gateway_local_domain.rs:309-310), unavailable after an offline restart. An in-memory render with a saved draft and failed workspace listing showed the draft but no editing textbox. Also, playground.tsx:111-126 clears a pending save on unmount without flushing it: editing and leaving before the 800 ms pause produced zero save calls in an independent UI probe. Acceptance: offline relaunch must allow opening, editing and retaining the saved workspace-labelled draft without a remote listing or valid execution reference; leaving the form must preserve pending edits. Run must still require fresh native admission and the correct key, with no reconnect replay. Exercise this through Core/App and the native T23 flow; the current restart test and N09 establish listing only.",
    "R2 — Preserve the SDK's unknown outcomes when opening an inference stream fails. gateway_inference.rs:349-366 derives rejection from the failure label, while :431-437 uses error.remote_outcome only to distinguish NotSent. The SDK's engine explicitly marks HTTP 5xx as RemoteOutcome::Unknown, but Unavailable falls into the desktop's Rejected branch. The supplied test at gateway_inference/main.rs:640-659 even expects 503 to be rejected. This also prevents a recovery record, because inference_settled retains only Unknown or Completed outcomes. Acceptance: opening failures must preserve NotSent/Rejected/Unknown from the SDK, independently of their sanitized failure message; cover 500/502/503/504, a lost handshake, and a malformed successful handshake, alongside definite 4xx refusal. Unknown runs must retain their trace and uncertainty across restart, send once, and never fall back or replay.",
    "R3 — Withdraw a run's presentation immediately when its inference credential retires. inference_domain.rs:254-259 includes the credential record in its binding test, but :289-290 retains an unbound run until settlement, and playground_view:297-303 checks only context and workspace. Configure/remove inference credentials deliberately preserve both context and workspace, so their state.changed publication can still include the old run and output while its cancellation is pending. The replacement test waits until playground becomes null and misses these intervening snapshots. Acceptance: every snapshot published after key replacement/removal is admitted must exclude the retired run and any late output, while its settlement can still create a sanitized recovery record. Check subscriptions and direct observations during cancellation, preserve unaffected reads/reviews/workspace selection, and verify the next run uses only the new credential.",
    "R4 — Bind log pagination to the applied query and distinguish a page cap from completion. LogsPanel.load defaults to the currently edited filters and appends nonzero pages without checking their query (gateway-observe.tsx:307-327,433-435). An independent execution loaded unfiltered page 0, changed Trace ID to trace-B, then pressed Read more: it requested page 1 of trace-B, displayed both queries' rows, and said '2 requests shown of 2 · all read'. Separately, gateway_observe.rs:470-474 forces more=false at page 39 even when a reported total exceeds the 1,000-row cap; the same UI reports all read. Acceptance: continuation must use the held query, or filter changes must restart at page 0; no mixed-query rows or stale continuations may commit. At the cap, report explicitly that more data exists or completeness is unknown, never all read. Cover changed trace/status/window, pending replies and capped pages through the real UI/Core contracts.",
    "R5 — Require known, workspace-specific Gateway facts before claiming completeness or clearing attention holds. observation.rs:145-153 creates gaps only for failure/quota/policy absence; a successful chart with nullable total or omitted error counts can therefore leave requests/errors unknown with no gap, allowing overview_view to report AllClear. observation_domain.rs:157-171 also treats usage_failure=None and partial=false as complete and applies that boolean to every gateway-* hold. A healthy read of workspace B consequently removes workspace A's acknowledged/snoozed hold, even though A was not reconciled; an unknown A result can remove it too. Acceptance: unknown Gateway activity must keep the face Gap and preserve relevant holds. A Gateway hold may end only from sufficiently complete facts for that hold's own workspace showing the condition absent. Cover nullable/unreported totals/errors, A acknowledged then B refreshed then A revisited, and late overview reads across a workspace change."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "G1 — C18 milestone 1 and its required stream/file fixtures are not fully dispositioned. D044 declares Responses and file workflows deferred, but supplies no supported/unsupported matrix tying that omission to the accepted SDK contracts and v1 requirements, or an authorized scope amendment. The pinned RuntimeClient exposes Responses operations. Qualify the applicable response/file subset and provide implementation/evidence for required workflows, or record the authorized disposition before claiming full C18 completion.",
    "G2 — Refresh causal evidence for R1–R5. The current native offline check verifies visibility rather than editing, the 503 integration assertion encodes the wrong outcome, and the supplied suites do not establish immediate key-retirement visibility, mixed-query/capped log handling, or workspace-specific/unknown Gateway hold reconciliation. Passing counts and mutation results do not close these cases."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "All four supplied fingerprints recompute exactly. Verified 595 source-inventory entries, 313 referenced hashes, command logs/artifacts, exact command sequences against checks.json, and the passing C17 predecessor packet/verdict/raw-output hashes.",
    "The architecture keeps SDK inference, observation projection and local persistence behind Rust authority, reuses the protected credential lifecycle, and adds no dependency or shipped JavaScript backend. The required changes concern behavior, binding and qualification rather than an unrelated architectural rewrite.",
    "Supplied checks report 374 desktop tests, 175 core library tests, eight Gateway inference integration tests and passing scoped Gateway-change/read, credential and IPC regressions. All 16 mutation probes report named guard failures; eight source hashes match, and four baseline targets passed three times each. These are inspected implementer-run results, not independently rerun application tests.",
    "The 11 C18 native checks and C01–C17 regression records report pass against fixture executable 74eccc3e2b93a809ff17776fddb6db3bb06da0de8408f33c7cd7fa35642128a1. Inspected the driver, observations and relevant Accessibility trees. Native acceptance was not independently rerun; spoken VoiceOver output is not recorded. N09 does not establish offline editing.",
    "The workload registration is retained in commit 3288e9a, its current hash matches the recorded registration, and all six acceptance statistics recompute within the original limits: first output p95 37.874 ms, 64 KiB completion p95 33.700 ms, stop p95 28.845 ms, responsiveness p95 24.257 ms, charts p95 120.155 ms and maximum process-tree RSS 433.6 MiB. Calibration failures remain recorded. These measurements concern the supplied synthetic workload and fixture bytes.",
    "Independent source-executing React/JSDOM probes ran entirely in memory with presentation/native-boundary stubs. They reproduced mixed-query pagination, the absence of offline draft editing controls, and loss of a pending draft save on unmount. Other findings follow from inspected source, tests and the pinned SDK's contracts; no new network reproduction was performed.",
    "Gateway/IAM/inference service evidence is synthetic. Live qualification remains C25 and signed installed-package qualification C26. C16's D034 owner acceptance still requires its separate passing re-review before P05 completion.",
    "No application source was changed, product endpoints called or credentials accessed. No application build or on-disk application test was run for this review. Only the designated verdict artifact was written."
  ],
